title: Jesus didn’t say He was one of many options.
paragraphs: Jesus didn’t say He was one of many options.

“I am the way, the truth, and the life.”
No man comes to the Father except through Him.

Truth isn’t plural.
Salvation isn’t negotiable.

That statement either changes everything…
or it offends everything.
Do you believe Jesus is the only way to heaven — or do you think there are many paths to God?
